pass_1.locations: Original seven-page publisher PDF, Online Methods p. 4, web lines 569–611, and p. 5 lines 621–625; defining scM&T JATS Methods citation
pass_1.finding: Independently read the coauthor-uploaded original publisher PDF. It prints the 5′-biotin-triethyleneglycol-AAGCAGTGGTATCAACGCAGAGTACT30VN-3′ bead capture primer, magnetic physical DNA/RNA split and four gDNA-pooling washes, on-bead reverse transcription with TSO AAGCAGTGGTATCAACGCAGAGTACrGrG+G (AC before modified G tail), and PCR primer AAGCAGTGGTATCAACGCAGAGT. The separate DNA branch uses MDA or PicoPlex; libraries use Nextera XT by vendor instructions. The AC TSO form differs from the scM&T model's prior ACAT inference and requires correction.

pass_2.locations: Original coauthor-uploaded publisher PDF, Online Methods p. 4 web lines 569–611 and p. 5 lines 621–625; scM&T JATS Methods line 84
pass_2.finding: Independently read original G&T Online Methods. The bead oligo has 5′ biotin-triethyleneglycol and T30VN; magnetic capture partitions poly(A) RNA from genomic DNA, with four bead washes pooled into the DNA fraction. On-bead RT uses TSO AAGCAGTGGTATCAACGCAGAGTACrGrG+G, with AC before the modified G tail, and PCR primer AAGCAGTGGTATCAACGCAGAGT. This source disfavors the prior scM&T ACAT TSO inference. Nextera XT preparation is delegated to manufacturer instructions.

source_checklist.locator: Smallwood et al. 2014 scBS-seq doi:10.1038/nmeth.3035; PMC4117646

pass_1.locations: Original Smallwood PMC4117646 JATS XML text lines 70–72 and 94–102, especially Single-Cell Library Preparation line 102; original Springer MOESM643 Supplementary Fig. 1–3 captions lines 1–33; local scBS source bundle scraper
pass_1.finding: Independently read the original scBS paper and figure captions. It uses five rounds of Klenow exo-minus priming with 5′-biotinylated oligo1-N9, streptavidin capture and alkali washes, then oligo2-N9 extension and PE1/indexed iPCRTag PCR. Its Supplementary Fig. 2 reports spurious poly-T reads. The scM&T methods explicitly modify this predecessor by using N6 and omitting first-strand capture; the scBS source cannot establish the scM&T-specific junction on its own.

pass_2.locations: Original Smallwood PMC4117646 JATS lines 75-115, specifically Single-Cell Library Preparation; nmeth.3035 Springer MOESM643 PDF text Supplementary Figs. 1-3 captions
pass_2.finding: Original scBS Methods print biotinylated oligo1-N9, oligo2-N9, repeated first-strand priming, streptavidin capture, PE1 and indexed iPCRTag. Angermueller explicitly changes to N6 and omits first-strand capture. Previous pass_1 cited nmeth.2639/PMC3959825, which is Picelli Smart-seq2, so it cannot count as a scBS source pass.

missing_claims.evidence: Inherited G&T and scBS chemistry plus vendor kit must be resolved before any missing claim is accepted.

conclusion: Independent defining-paper and source-supplement passes found an observed first-strand primer concatemer off-product and corrected swapped predecessor citations. Two independent readings of G&T original Online Methods establish the AC TSO and modified bead capture primer used to correct the scM&T model; two readings of the scBS original establish that branch. G&T S1, Smallwood's binary supplement and the historical Nextera XT guide remain unread, so no missing-information claim is accepted.
